suites.title: Welcome & Launch Routing
suites.description: Where the app sends you when it opens, before and after you've finished onboarding.

cases.title: First launch goes to Welcome

steps.action: Open the app for the very first time.
steps.expected_result: The app opens on the Welcome screen.

steps.action: Read the Welcome screen.
steps.expected_result: Shows the "Reentry Roadmap" title, a "Let's Go!" button, and an intro message. No back button.

steps.action: Tap Let's Go!.
steps.expected_result: The app moves to the first onboarding step.

cases.title: Returning user skips straight to My Path

steps.action: Close and reopen the app after already finishing onboarding.
steps.expected_result: The app opens directly on My Path. Welcome and onboarding are not shown.

cases.title: No internet on launch still opens Welcome

steps.action: Turn off the network, then open the app for the first time.
steps.expected_result: The app still opens on Welcome instead of a blank or stuck screen.

cases.title: Splash screen stays up until the app is ready

steps.action: Open the app and watch the transition from splash to the first screen.
steps.expected_result: The splash screen stays up until everything is ready, then Welcome appears already fully styled.

steps.action: Check the text as soon as it appears.
steps.expected_result: No plain system font shows briefly before the real font loads.

cases.title: Welcome stays responsive while startup work runs in the background

steps.action: Open the app and immediately tap Let's Go!.
steps.expected_result: The button responds right away, with no delay or freeze.

steps.action: If any background setup fails silently.
steps.expected_result: Welcome still works normally and shows no error message to the user.

cases.title: Welcome has no back navigation

steps.action: On Welcome, try to go back using the device's back gesture or button.
steps.expected_result: Nothing happens — there is no earlier screen to return to.

suites.title: Onboarding Step 1 - Birthdate & Location
suites.description: The "Tell us about yourself" screen: birth month/year, state, area, and time in the community.

cases.title: Complete Step 1 for a state that has local areas

steps.action: Enter a valid birth month and a 4-digit birth year.
steps.expected_result: Both fields accept the entry with no error.

steps.action: Choose a state that has local areas.
steps.expected_result: An area dropdown appears for that state.

steps.action: Choose an area, choose how long you've been in the community, then tap Next.
steps.expected_result: Your answers save and the app moves to the goals screen.

cases.title: Next is blocked until a required Area is chosen

steps.action: Fill in birth month, year, and a state that has local areas, but skip the area.
steps.expected_result: No error yet — the screen just waits.

steps.action: Tap Next.
steps.expected_result: An error message asks you to pick an area. Nothing saves and nothing moves forward.

steps.action: Pick an area, then tap Next again.
steps.expected_result: The error clears and the app moves to the goals screen.

cases.title: Next checks birth month, then birth year, one at a time

steps.action: Leave birth month blank, fill in everything else, then tap Next.
steps.expected_result: An error asks you to select your birth month. Nothing saves.

cases.title: No area dropdown for states without local areas

steps.action: Choose a state that does not have local areas.
steps.expected_result: No area dropdown shows up for that state.

steps.action: Fill in the rest and tap Next.
steps.expected_result: The screen moves forward with no area required.

cases.title: Time-in-community has no placeholder text but isn't required

steps.action: Open the "How long have you been in the community?" dropdown before choosing anything.
steps.expected_result: It shows only the list of options — no placeholder text.

steps.action: Leave it blank and fill everything else in, then tap Next.
steps.expected_result: The screen should not moves forward and should give a validation message

cases.title: Let's Go

steps.action: Launch the app and Click on Get Started
steps.expected_result:
It will navigate to next screen - Tell us about your self.
Ensure no UI is broken

steps.action: Click on Next button at the bottom right of the screen without adding inputs to the fields
steps.expected_result: will display the validation message for the first field

steps.action: add input the first fields - Month and year and click Next
steps.expected_result: will display validation message for 2nd field (State)

steps.action: add input the first and second fields - Month, year and State then click Next
steps.expected_result: will display validation message for 3rd field (community)

steps.action: Click on When were you born - Month and Year field
steps.expected_result: - it will open a bottom sheet to select the month and year.

steps.action: On bottom sheet click on cancel and Done button
steps.expected_result:
- cancel will dismiss the bottom sheet 
- Done will add the month and year to the fields.

steps.action: Select month and year and click on Done button
steps.expected_result: Will add the selected month and year the fields.

steps.action: Click on state field and select a state from given state list
steps.expected_result:
- Will open a drop down having a list of states
- able to select the state - it will be added to the field.

steps.action: Click on Community field select an option from given options.
steps.expected_result: able to select an option and the selected option will be displayed in the field.

steps.action: Click on Next button after filling all the fields
steps.expected_result: Navigate to Get Started screen

cases.title: Get Started

steps.action: You will be seeing 6 options to select only 3
steps.expected_result: able to select any 3 options

steps.action: Click again on the selected option
steps.expected_result: selection will be removed

steps.action: click on Next button without selecting any of the option
steps.expected_result: Will display the validation message

steps.action: Select any 1 of the option and click on Next button
steps.expected_result: Will navigate to next screen

steps.action: Select any 4 or all of the options
steps.expected_result:
- Would not be able to select more than 3 options
- Will give a validation message if trying to select the 4th option.

steps.action: Select any 3 options and click on Next button
steps.expected_result: Will navigate to Need Immediate Help? screen.

cases.title: Need Immediate Help?

suites.title: Onboarding Step 2 - Goal Category Picks
suites.description: The "Get Started" screen where you pick up to 3 goals.

cases.title: Pick up to 3 goals and continue

steps.action: Tap 3 different goal tiles.
steps.expected_result: Each one highlights as selected.

steps.action: Tap Next.
steps.expected_result: Your 3 picks save and the app moves to the next screen.

cases.title: A 4th pick is blocked with a clear message

steps.action: With 3 goals already picked, tap a 4th tile.
steps.expected_result: It doesn't get selected. A message says you can pick at most 3.

steps.action: Unpick one of the first three, then tap the 4th tile.
steps.expected_result: The message clears and the 4th tile can now be picked.

cases.title: Next is blocked if nothing is picked

steps.action: Tap Next with no goals picked.
steps.expected_result: A message asks you to pick at least 1. Nothing saves.

steps.action: Pick just 1 goal and tap Next again.
steps.expected_result: It saves and moves forward with that single pick.

cases.title: Tapping a picked goal again un-picks it

steps.action: Tap a goal to pick it, then tap the same tile again.
steps.expected_result: It un-picks. Tapping the same tile twice never counts as picking it twice.

suites.title: Onboarding Step 3 - Finish
suites.description: The "Need immediate help?" screen that finishes onboarding.

cases.title: Finish completes onboarding and opens My Path

steps.action: Tap Finish.
steps.expected_result: The button shows it's working and can't be tapped again.

steps.action: Wait for it to finish.
steps.expected_result: The app moves to My Path. Going back afterward does not return to onboarding.

cases.title: Tapping Finish twice quickly only sends one request

steps.action: Tap Finish twice very quickly.
steps.expected_result: Only one attempt actually goes through.

cases.title: This screen shows help info, not goal content

steps.action: Read the screen before tapping anything.
steps.expected_result: It shows "Need immediate help?" with a message about emergency resources — no goals or roadmap content here.

cases.title: Onboarding stays marked complete on the next app open

steps.action: Finish onboarding, then fully close and reopen the app.
steps.expected_result: The app opens straight to My Path, skipping Welcome and onboarding entirely.

suites.title: Bottom Tab Navigation
suites.description: The 4-tab bar: My Path, Resources, Calendar, and More.

cases.title: All four tabs open without errors

steps.action: Tap through My Path, Resources, Calendar, More, and back to My Path.
steps.expected_result: Every tab opens correctly. The bar always shows the same 4 tabs in the same order.

cases.title: The tab bar never covers the last item in a list

steps.action: Scroll to the bottom of a long list on My Path, Resources, or Calendar.
steps.expected_result: The last item is fully visible above the tab bar — nothing is hidden behind it.

cases.title: Every screen has a real, readable title

steps.action: Open every screen you can reach from the tabs, including task lists and task details.
steps.expected_result: Each one shows a normal, human-readable title — never raw text like "[id]" or "(tabs)".

cases.title: Back button only shows up where it makes sense

steps.action: Check the top of My Path, Resources, Calendar, and More.
steps.expected_result: None of them show a back button.

steps.action: Check the top of Explore and any screen reached by tapping into a category or task.
steps.expected_result: These do show a back button, since you got to them by drilling in from a tab.

cases.title: Switching tabs while something is loading doesn't break anything

steps.action: Open Calendar, and before it finishes loading, switch to another tab.
steps.expected_result: Nothing crashes.

steps.action: Go back to Calendar.
steps.expected_result: It loads normally, as if nothing happened.

suites.title: My Path - Category List & Progress
suites.description: The main My Path screen: your saved goal categories and how far along you are on each.

cases.title: An empty path shows the Explore prompt

steps.action: Open My Path with no goals added yet.
steps.expected_result: A message invites you to explore your options. There's one button labeled "Explore".

steps.action: Tap Explore.
steps.expected_result: The app opens the Explore screen.

cases.title: A path with goals shows accurate progress on each one

steps.action: Add a few goals to My Path with different amounts of progress on each.
steps.expected_result: Each one shows a status that matches its real progress — not started, in progress, or done.

steps.action: Check the button at the bottom.
steps.expected_result: It now says "Explore More" instead of "Explore", and still opens Explore.

cases.title: Tapping a goal opens its list of tasks

steps.action: Tap any goal on My Path.
steps.expected_result: The app opens that goal's task list.

cases.title: My Path refreshes every time you return to it

steps.action: Leave My Path, complete a task somewhere else in the app, then come back to My Path.
steps.expected_result: The progress you see updates automatically — no manual refresh needed.

cases.title: A background update never blocks the screen from loading

steps.action: Open My Path on a device that's just changed time zones.
steps.expected_result: The screen still loads and shows your goals normally, even if the time zone update itself has a problem.

cases.title: A loading error keeps your last-seen list on screen

steps.action: After My Path has already loaded once, force the next refresh to fail.
steps.expected_result: Your goals stay visible as they were. An error message shows below the list instead of clearing it.

cases.title: The very first load shows a simple spinner, not the empty message

steps.action: Open My Path for the first time this session.
steps.expected_result: A spinner shows while it loads — the "nothing on your roadmap" message never flashes first.

cases.title: Goal titles never flash blank before showing the real name

steps.action: Watch a goal row load on a slow connection.
steps.expected_result: The real title appears directly — no blank or placeholder text shows first.

cases.title: Explore and Explore More look and behave the same way

steps.action: Compare the button on an empty path versus a populated one.
steps.expected_result: Same style and same destination — only the wording changes.

suites.title: My Path - Task List
suites.description: The screen listing all the tasks inside one goal category.

cases.title: The task list shows the goal's name and all its tasks

steps.action: Open a goal that has several tasks.
steps.expected_result: The screen title matches the goal's real name, and every task shows up in the list.

cases.title: Tapping a task opens its details

steps.action: Tap any task in the list.
steps.expected_result: The app opens that task's detail screen.

cases.title: A goal with no tasks shows a clear empty message

steps.action: Open a goal that has no tasks yet.
steps.expected_result: A message says there are no tasks for this goal yet — not a blank screen.

cases.title: A missing goal shows an error instead of breaking

steps.action: Try to open a goal that no longer exists.
steps.expected_result: An error message says the goal couldn't be loaded, and the task list stays empty.

cases.title: A failure loading tasks shows its own error message

steps.action: Force the task list itself to fail loading, while the goal name still loads fine.
steps.expected_result: The title still shows, but an error says the tasks couldn't be loaded.

cases.title: Reopening a goal always shows the latest task status

steps.action: Open a goal, leave it, complete one of its tasks another way, then open the same goal again.
steps.expected_result: The updated task status shows right away — no restart needed.

cases.title: Create Appointment
Delete Reminder

suites.title: My Path - Task Detail & Completion
suites.description: A single task's screen, and marking it done or undone.

cases.title: Marking a task done saves it and returns you to the list

steps.action: Open a task that isn't done yet and check its action button's wording.
steps.expected_result: It shows whatever custom label this task uses instead of a generic label.

steps.action: Tap the button to mark it done.
steps.expected_result: The task saves as complete and the screen returns you to the task list automatically.

cases.title: Undoing a completed task asks you to confirm first

steps.action: Open a task that's already marked done and tap its "Completed" button.
steps.expected_result: Nothing changes yet — a confirmation pop-up asks if you're sure you want to mark it incomplete.

steps.action: Tap "Keep completed".
steps.expected_result: The pop-up closes and the task stays marked done.

cases.title: Confirming the undo keeps you on the same screen

steps.action: From that same confirmation pop-up, tap "Mark incomplete".
steps.expected_result: The task switches back to not-done, and — unlike marking it done — you stay on this same screen instead of being sent back.

cases.title: A save failure shows an error and doesn't fake success

steps.action: Force the save to fail while marking a task done.
steps.expected_result: An error message shows, the task stays as it was, and you are not sent back to the list.

steps.action: Force the same kind of failure while confirming the undo.
steps.expected_result: The same error shows and the confirmation pop-up stays open.

cases.title: The task shows its description, or a fallback if there isn't one

steps.action: Open a task that has a full description.
steps.expected_result: That description shows below the title.

steps.action: Open a different task with no description but a short note instead.
steps.expected_result: The short note shows in that same spot.

cases.title: "Let's Go!" always opens the right task's resources

steps.action: Tap "Let's Go!" on any task.
steps.expected_result: It opens the resources for this exact task — never a different one.

cases.title: An invalid task shows a not-found message

steps.action: Try to open a task that doesn't exist.
steps.expected_result: A message says the task couldn't be found, instead of a broken screen.

cases.title: The goal name only shows above the task title when it's available

steps.action: Open a task normally.
steps.expected_result: Its goal's name shows in a smaller line above the task title.

steps.action: Open a task where the goal info fails to load.
steps.expected_result: That small line is simply left out — the task itself still shows normally.

suites.title: My Path - Task Resource Feed
suites.description: The full-screen, swipe-through feed of resources attached to a task.

cases.title: The feed swipes through every resource in order, ending on a final page

steps.action: Open a task that has 3 different resources.
steps.expected_result: Each resource is its own full page, shown in the same order the team set, followed by one final "end" page.

steps.action: Swipe through all of them one at a time.
steps.expected_result: Each swipe moves exactly one page. A counter shows your position, and disappears on the final page.

cases.title: Viewing a resource only logs once per visit

steps.action: Swipe to a resource and let it settle on screen.
steps.expected_result: That view gets recorded once.

steps.action: Swipe away and then swipe back to the same page.
steps.expected_result: It does not get recorded a second time for that same visit.

cases.title: Hotline resources show a working call button, or say it's unavailable

steps.action: Open a hotline resource that has a phone number.
steps.expected_result: A "Call" button shows the number and works when tapped, dialing that number.

steps.action: Open a hotline resource with no phone number.
steps.expected_result: The button says "Phone unavailable" and can't be tapped.

cases.title: Website resources open in the browser

steps.action: Open a website resource with a working link and tap "Open Website".
steps.expected_result: The link opens.

steps.action: Open one with no link set.
steps.expected_result: The button can't be tapped and nothing opens.

cases.title: Text-only resources never show an action button

steps.action: Open a text resource.
steps.expected_result: It shows the title and the text — no button at all, not even a grayed-out one.

steps.action: Tap anywhere on the text.
steps.expected_result: Nothing happens besides normal scrolling.

cases.title: Video resources go straight to the player

steps.action: Open a video resource.
steps.expected_result: It goes straight to a full-screen video, with no extra title/description/button page in between.

cases.title: A task with no resources shows a message with a way out

steps.action: Open the resource feed for a task that has none.
steps.expected_result: A message says there are no resources yet, with a Close button — no feed shows underneath it.

cases.title: A loading failure shows an error with a way out

steps.action: Force this screen to fail loading.
steps.expected_result: An error message shows with a Close button — no partial or broken feed shows underneath.

cases.title: Closing from the end page always takes you somewhere sensible

steps.action: Swipe to the final page and tap Back (or the X).
steps.expected_result: You return to the task you came from. If there's nowhere to go back to, you land on My Path instead — never a dead screen.

cases.title: The status bar only turns light-colored during video pages

steps.action: Swipe from any resource onto a video.
steps.expected_result: The status bar switches to a light color to match the dark video background.

steps.action: Swipe off the video to any other page.
steps.expected_result: The status bar switches back to normal.

suites.title: Video Playback - Direct Video
suites.description: Playing an uploaded/direct video file (not YouTube) inside a resource page.

cases.title: A direct video starts playing on its own when opened

steps.action: Swipe onto a direct video resource.
steps.expected_result: It starts playing right away, with normal video controls.

cases.title: Swiping away pauses the video right away

steps.action: While a direct video is playing, swipe to another page.
steps.expected_result: It pauses immediately instead of continuing to play in the background.

cases.title: Tapping the video pauses and resumes it

steps.action: Tap the middle of a playing video.
steps.expected_result: It pauses, and a play icon fades in.

steps.action: Tap again.
steps.expected_result: It resumes (or restarts if it had already ended), and the play icon fades back out.

cases.title: Replaying after the video ends starts over cleanly

steps.action: Let a video play all the way to the end.
steps.expected_result: It stops at the end and shows the play icon.

steps.action: Tap to play again.
steps.expected_result: It restarts from the beginning instead of doing nothing.

cases.title: A broken video shows a clear error with a Retry option

steps.action: Open a video with a broken link.
steps.expected_result: An error message says playback failed, with a Retry button.

steps.action: Tap Retry.
steps.expected_result: It tries loading the same video again from the start, and plays normally if the link works this time.

cases.title: A loading spinner shows only while the video is actually loading

steps.action: Open a video and watch it right when the page appears.
steps.expected_result: A "Loading video" spinner shows briefly.

steps.action: Once it starts playing.
steps.expected_result: The spinner disappears and doesn't come back just from pausing and resuming.

cases.title: Leaving the resource feed always stops the video

steps.action: While a video is playing, leave the resource feed entirely (not just swipe pages).
steps.expected_result: The video stops. No crash happens even if it stops mid-play.

cases.title: A resource with no video link shows "unavailable"

steps.action: Open a video resource that has no link at all.
steps.expected_result: It shows a "Video unavailable" message instead of trying to play anything.

suites.title: Video Playback - YouTube Embed
suites.description: Playing a YouTube video inside a resource page.

cases.title: Different YouTube link formats all play the same video

steps.action: Open a resource using a full YouTube watch link.
steps.expected_result: The correct video loads.

steps.action: Open a different resource where just the bare video ID is stored instead of a full link.
steps.expected_result: The exact same video loads, without needing the full link.

cases.title: Short links and other YouTube link styles all work

steps.action: Try a youtu.be short link.
steps.expected_result: The right video loads.

steps.action: Try embed, shorts, and live-style YouTube links.
steps.expected_result: All of them load the correct video too — none show as unavailable.

cases.title: On phones, the video plays on its own and pauses when you leave

steps.action: Swipe onto a YouTube resource on a phone.
steps.expected_result: It starts playing on its own once it's ready.

steps.action: Swipe away from it.
steps.expected_result: It stops right away.

cases.title: On web, the video needs a tap on YouTube's own play button

steps.action: Open the same resource on a web browser.
steps.expected_result: It does not start playing on its own, even though the page is open.

steps.action: Tap the play button inside the YouTube video itself.
steps.expected_result: It starts playing normally from that tap.

cases.title: Nothing sits on top of the YouTube video blocking your taps

steps.action: Try tapping the YouTube video's own controls (play, pause, fullscreen) on any device.
steps.expected_result: Every tap reaches the video player correctly — nothing invisible is blocking it.

cases.title: An unusable YouTube link shows "unavailable", not a broken player

steps.action: Open a resource with a YouTube-style link that doesn't actually point to a real video.
steps.expected_result: It shows a message saying the video is unavailable, and never tries to load a player.

cases.title: A YouTube playback error shows a Retry option

steps.action: Open a YouTube video that's been removed or blocked.
steps.expected_result: An error message shows, with a Retry button.

steps.action: Tap Retry.
steps.expected_result: It tries loading fresh, rather than doing nothing.

cases.title: YouTube videos keep their normal shape, never stretched full-screen

steps.action: Compare a YouTube video's size on screen to a direct video's size.
steps.expected_result: The YouTube video keeps its normal proportions with black bars if needed, while the direct video fills the screen. They should not look the same.

cases.title: Coming back to a YouTube page starts fresh, not from where you left it

steps.action: Swipe off a YouTube video mid-play, then swipe back to it.
steps.expected_result: It shows loading again and starts over, rather than picking up where it left off.

suites.title: Resources Tab
suites.description: The Resources tab: category carousels of helpful links plus local directories.

cases.title: Resources are grouped by category in the right order

steps.action: Open Resources with a couple of categories, each with several resources.
steps.expected_result: Resources appear grouped under their category, in the order the team set.

cases.title: Local directories only show up for your area

steps.action: Open Resources with a profile location that has matching local directories.
steps.expected_result: A "Local directories" section shows at the bottom of the screen.

steps.action: Open Resources with a profile location that has none.
steps.expected_result: That section is simply left out — nothing empty shows in its place.

cases.title: A directory-loading problem doesn't affect the rest of the screen

steps.action: Force the local directories to fail loading while everything else loads fine.
steps.expected_result: The categories still show normally. Only the directories section is missing, with no visible error.

cases.title: A loading failure shows a Try Again option

steps.action: Force the whole Resources screen to fail loading.
steps.expected_result: An error message shows with a "Try again" button, and nothing else shows underneath it.

steps.action: Tap "Try again".
steps.expected_result: It reloads and shows the categories normally if it succeeds this time.

cases.title: No resources at all shows a simple empty message

steps.action: Open Resources when there's nothing to show.
steps.expected_result: A message says there are no resources available yet.

cases.title: Pulling down refreshes everything on the screen

steps.action: Pull down on the Resources screen to refresh.
steps.expected_result: A refresh indicator shows, then everything updates.

steps.action: Force that refresh to fail.
steps.expected_result: An error message shows, but everything that was already on screen stays visible.

cases.title: Resources has no back button, like the other main tabs

steps.action: Open the Resources tab.
steps.expected_result: There's no back button at the top, same as the other main tabs.

cases.title: Both resource cards and directory links open when tapped

steps.action: Tap a resource card in any category.
steps.expected_result: It opens correctly.

steps.action: Tap a local directory link.
steps.expected_result: It also opens correctly.

suites.title: Explore - Category Browser
suites.description: The full list of goal categories you can browse and add.

cases.title: Explore shows every category, even ones already on your path

steps.action: Add a category to My Path, then open Explore.
steps.expected_result: That category still shows up in the list along with every other one — Explore isn't filtered down.

cases.title: Tapping a category opens its details

steps.action: Tap any category in the Explore list.
steps.expected_result: It opens that category's detail screen.

cases.title: No categories available shows a clear message

steps.action: Open Explore when there are no categories at all.
steps.expected_result: A message says there are none available yet.

cases.title: A loading failure clears the list and shows an error

steps.action: Force the category list to fail loading.
steps.expected_result: The list is empty and an error message asks you to try again.

cases.title: Explore refreshes every time you open it

steps.action: Open Explore, leave, add a new category somewhere else, then open Explore again.
steps.expected_result: The new category shows up without needing to restart the app.

cases.title: Explore has a back button since it's reached from My Path

steps.action: Open Explore from the Explore button on My Path.
steps.expected_result: A back button shows, and tapping it returns you to My Path.

suites.title: Explore - Category Detail & Add to Path
suites.description: A single category's detail screen and the Add to My Path button.

cases.title: Adding a category saves it and updates the button permanently

steps.action: Open a category not yet on your path and tap "Add to My Path".
steps.expected_result: The button shows it's working.

steps.action: Wait for it to finish.
steps.expected_result: The button now says "Added to My Path" and stays that way, even without leaving the screen.

cases.title: A category already on your path opens already marked Added

steps.action: Open a category that's already on your path.
steps.expected_result: The button already shows "Added to My Path" and can't be tapped — no action needed.

cases.title: Extra taps on Add don't cause double actions

steps.action: Tap "Add to My Path" twice quickly.
steps.expected_result: Only one add actually happens.

steps.action: Tap the button again after it already says "Added to My Path".
steps.expected_result: Nothing happens — it's already done.

cases.title: A save failure shows an error and lets you retry

steps.action: Force the add action to fail.
steps.expected_result: An error message shows, and the button goes back to a normal, tappable "Add to My Path" state.

cases.title: The category shows its full description, or a shorter one if that's all there is

steps.action: Open a category that has a full description.
steps.expected_result: That full description shows.

steps.action: Open one that only has a short description.
steps.expected_result: The short one shows instead, in the same place.

cases.title: An invalid category shows a not-found message

steps.action: Try to open a category that doesn't exist.
steps.expected_result: A message says it couldn't be found, instead of a blank screen.

cases.title: Coming back to this screen re-checks whether it's already added

steps.action: Add a category, leave the screen without fully closing it, then come back.
steps.expected_result: It correctly still shows "Added to My Path", double-checked fresh rather than just remembered.

suites.title: Calendar & Appointments
suites.description: Adding, viewing, and deleting appointments, with optional reminders.

cases.title: Adding an appointment with a reminder saves it correctly

steps.action: Tap the + button, fill in a name, a date and time that's today or later, check Reminder, then tap Add.
steps.expected_result: The appointment saves.

steps.action: Check the list.
steps.expected_result: The new appointment appears, and its reminder is recorded.

cases.title: Adding an appointment without a reminder also works

steps.action: Repeat the same steps but leave Reminder unchecked.
steps.expected_result: It saves and appears in the list the same way, just without a reminder recorded.

cases.title: A past date is rejected before saving

steps.action: Pick a date before today and tap Add.
steps.expected_result: An error message asks you to pick a valid date and time. Nothing saves.

cases.title: Add stays disabled until all fields are filled in

steps.action: Fill in only the name, leaving date and time blank.
steps.expected_result: The Add button stays disabled.

steps.action: Fill in the date and time too.
steps.expected_result: Add becomes tappable.

cases.title: Deleting an appointment asks for confirmation first

steps.action: Tap the delete icon on an appointment.
steps.expected_result: A confirmation message asks if you're sure, naming the appointment. Nothing is deleted yet.

steps.action: Confirm the delete.
steps.expected_result: That appointment shows it's being removed, then disappears from the list.

cases.title: Cancelling a delete leaves the appointment untouched

steps.action: Open the delete confirmation, then tap Cancel.
steps.expected_result: Nothing is deleted. The appointment stays exactly as it was.

cases.title: Only one appointment can be deleted at a time

steps.action: Start deleting one appointment, then immediately try to delete a different one before the first finishes.
steps.expected_result: The other delete buttons are disabled until the first delete finishes.

cases.title: Saving, deleting, and loading each show their own clear error

steps.action: Force a new appointment to fail saving.
steps.expected_result: An error says it couldn't save, and the form stays open with your entries intact.

steps.action: Force a delete to fail.
steps.expected_result: An error says it couldn't delete, and the appointment stays in the list.

steps.action: Force the calendar to fail loading.
steps.expected_result: An error says the calendar couldn't load.

cases.title: The list always stays sorted by date and time

steps.action: Add a new appointment dated earlier than one already in the list.
steps.expected_result: The list re-sorts immediately — the new one shows above the later one, not just added to the bottom.

cases.title: An empty calendar shows helpful example text

steps.action: Open Calendar with no appointments yet.
steps.expected_result: The empty message gives real examples, like probation meetings or court dates, not a generic "nothing here" line.

suites.title: More Tab & Account Deletion
suites.description: The More tab, and deleting your account.

cases.title: Confirming account deletion clears everything and returns to Welcome

steps.action: On More, tap "Delete account", then confirm.
steps.expected_result: The button shows it's working.

steps.action: Wait for it to finish.
steps.expected_result: Your account and local data are cleared, and the app returns to the Welcome screen.

cases.title: A deletion failure keeps your account and lets you try again

steps.action: Force the account deletion to fail.
steps.expected_result: An error message says it couldn't be deleted. Nothing is removed, and the confirmation stays open so you can try again.

cases.title: Cancelling the confirmation never deletes anything

steps.action: Tap "Delete account", then tap Cancel in the confirmation.
steps.expected_result: Nothing is deleted. The message clears.

cases.title: A partial failure after deletion still shows as an error

steps.action: Force the account to delete successfully, but the sign-out step afterward to fail.
steps.expected_result: The user still sees the standard "couldn't delete, try again" error, even though the account itself was removed on the backend.

cases.title: You can't dismiss the confirmation while deletion is in progress

steps.action: While the delete request is in progress, try to close the confirmation by tapping outside it or pressing back.
steps.expected_result: It stays open until the request finishes.

cases.title: After deletion, the app works like a fresh install

steps.action: Delete your account and land on Welcome.
steps.expected_result: Tapping Let's Go! again starts a completely fresh onboarding, with nothing carried over from the deleted account.

cases.title: The More tab only has one option today

steps.action: Open the More tab.
steps.expected_result: "Delete account" is the only option shown.

cases.title: A retry after a failed deletion works without restarting the app

steps.action: After a failed deletion, fix the problem and tap Delete again from the still-open confirmation.
steps.expected_result: It goes through successfully this time, with no need to reopen the screen or restart the app.

suites.title: Session Setup on Launch
suites.description: What happens behind the scenes to set up your account the first time the app opens, and every time after.

cases.title: A brand-new install sets up a fresh account automatically

steps.action: Open the app for the first time, with no account set up yet.
steps.expected_result: A new account is created automatically in the background, with no sign-up screen needed.

cases.title: A returning user's existing account is reused, not recreated

steps.action: Reopen the app with an account that was already set up before.
steps.expected_result: The same account is reused — nothing is recreated from scratch.

cases.title: An account created a different way is still recognized correctly

steps.action: Simulate an account record that was created through a different process than usual.
steps.expected_result: The app still recognizes it as existing and does not try to create a duplicate.

cases.title: Starting several account-dependent actions at once still sets things up only once

steps.action: Trigger two different features that both need an account ready at almost the same moment during startup.
steps.expected_result: The account setup work happens once, not twice, and both features end up working.

cases.title: A failure checking for an existing account doesn't quietly sign in as a new one

steps.action: Force the check for an existing account to fail with an error.
steps.expected_result: The setup process stops and reports that error — it does not pretend there was no account and create a new one anyway.

cases.title: A setup failure at launch never shows an error to the user

steps.action: Force the background account setup to fail when the app opens.
steps.expected_result: Welcome or My Path still shows normally with no error message — this all happens quietly in the background.

cases.title: A failed setup attempt doesn't block the next attempt from working

steps.action: Force one setup attempt to fail, then trigger another account-dependent action afterward.
steps.expected_result: The next attempt starts fresh and can succeed — it doesn't keep repeating the same failure.

suites.title: Analytics Events
suites.description: Which screens and actions are tracked, and which known gaps exist today.

cases.title: Only certain screens log a screen view — check which ones do and don't

steps.action: Visit Welcome, the three onboarding steps, My Path, Resources, Calendar, Explore, and a task's resource feed.
steps.expected_result: Each one logs a screen view.

steps.action: Visit the task list, task detail, a category's detail screen, and the More tab.
steps.expected_result: None of these four log a screen view today. Confirm with the team whether that's expected before treating it as a bug.

cases.title: Tracked actions log with the correct, exact name every time

steps.action: Trigger each tracked action once: tapping Let's Go!, finishing Step 1, picking or unpicking a goal, adding a category from Explore, finishing onboarding, opening a task, completing a task, viewing a resource, opening a resource, and setting a reminder.
steps.expected_result: Each one logs under its correct name, consistently, every time it happens.

cases.title: Opening a local directory link is tracked the same way as opening a resource

steps.action: Tap a local directory link on the Resources tab.
steps.expected_result: It logs as an opened resource, tagged as a directory. There's a separate "directory opened" tracking type defined that isn't actually used here — flag this as a known gap for the team, not a bug.

cases.title: Calling a hotline isn't tracked as its own distinct action yet

steps.action: Tap the Call button on a hotline resource.
steps.expected_result: It logs as an opened resource and a viewed resource. There's a separate "helpline called" tracking type defined that isn't wired up to this yet — flag this as a known gap.

cases.title: "Resource saved" and "category added" tracking types aren't wired up either

steps.action: Try every action in Resources and Explore that sounds like it should "save" something, including adding a category to your path.
steps.expected_result: Adding a category logs correctly under its own name. Two other tracking types exist in the system for "resource saved" and "category added" but neither one ever actually logs — flag both as known gaps.

cases.title: Tasks are tracked under My Path even though their own screens don't log a view

steps.action: Open a task and mark it complete.
steps.expected_result: The completion is tracked and labeled as happening on the My Path screen, even though the task list and task detail screens don't log their own separate screen view. Confirm with the team this is intentional grouping, not a mislabeling bug.

suites.title: Network / Interruption / Device-State
suites.description: What happens when the connection drops, the app is backgrounded, or the device changes state.

cases.title: Losing connection shows a clear error on every main screen, not a crash

steps.action: Turn on airplane mode, then open My Path, Resources, Explore, and Calendar for the first time this session.
steps.expected_result: Each one shows its own clear "couldn't load, try again" message instead of crashing or spinning forever.

steps.action: Turn airplane mode off and retry each screen.
steps.expected_result: Each one loads normally without needing to restart the app.

cases.title: Backgrounding the app during video playback stops the sound

steps.action: Start a video playing, then put the app in the background.
steps.expected_result: The video stops playing — it doesn't keep playing sound with the screen off.

steps.action: Bring the app back to the foreground.
steps.expected_result: Only one video resumes (or waits for a tap) — never two overlapping sounds.

cases.title: Backgrounding mid-save doesn't silently lose the change

steps.action: Start marking a task complete, saving an appointment, or saving an onboarding step, then immediately background the app before it finishes.
steps.expected_result: Either the save completes anyway, or it fails and shows an error when you come back — it never looks saved on screen while nothing actually saved.

cases.title: Changing your time zone updates on the next visit to My Path

steps.action: Change your device's time zone, then reopen or revisit My Path.
steps.expected_result: Your saved time zone updates automatically — no need to redo onboarding or reinstall.

cases.title: Resizing the window doesn't break the resource feed

steps.action: On a web browser, resize the window while viewing the task resource feed.
steps.expected_result: Swiping still moves exactly one resource at a time, and videos resize correctly to fit.

cases.title: A slow device doesn't let you accidentally advance onboarding twice

steps.action: On a slow device, fill in Step 1 and tap Next several times quickly while it's saving.
steps.expected_result: Only one save actually goes through, and you're only moved forward once.

cases.title: Closing the app mid-onboarding starts over rather than resuming halfway

steps.action: Finish Step 1, then close the app before finishing Step 2, and reopen it.
steps.expected_result: The app treats onboarding as unfinished and starts again from Welcome, rather than resuming exactly where you left off. Confirm with the team this is expected, not lost progress.

cases.title: A dropped connection while a YouTube video is loading eventually shows an error

steps.action: Start loading a YouTube video, then cut the connection before it finishes loading.
steps.expected_result: It eventually shows an error rather than spinning forever. If it does spin forever, flag this as a known gap — there's no visible timeout for this case.

cases.title: Backgrounding and foregrounding the app doesn't double-log a screen view

steps.action: Background the app and immediately bring it back while staying on the same screen.
steps.expected_result: No duplicate screen-view is logged just from that — it should only log when you actually open or return to a screen.

suites.title: Cross-App Regression
suites.description: Full run-throughs and checks that span the whole app. Run these first on every build.

cases.title: The single most valuable run: full onboarding through a completed task

steps.action: From a fresh install, go through Welcome, Let's Go!, Step 1, Step 2, Step 3, and land on My Path.
steps.expected_result: Every step saves and moves forward correctly with no dead ends.

steps.action: From My Path: open Explore, add a category, open it, open a task, mark it complete, and view its resources including a video.
steps.expected_result: The entire chain works in one pass with no crashes.

cases.title: Deleting your account and starting fresh right after works cleanly

steps.action: Delete your account, land on Welcome, then immediately start onboarding again.
steps.expected_result: Nothing from the deleted account — old goals, old tasks, old appointments — carries over into the new one.

cases.title: The app never shows a dark theme, anywhere

steps.action: Switch your device to dark mode, then walk through Welcome, onboarding, all four tabs, Explore, task detail, and video playback.
steps.expected_result: Every screen stays on the same light look throughout — nothing changes color.

cases.title: Text always uses the app's own font, never a system fallback

steps.action: Open the app fresh and check text on several screens right away.
steps.expected_result: The correct font shows immediately — no brief flash of a different, plain font.

cases.title: No screen ever shows a raw, unfinished title

steps.action: Walk through every screen: onboarding, all tabs, Explore, task lists, task details, and the resource feed.
steps.expected_result: Every title is a normal, readable name — never raw text like "[id]" or "(tabs)".

cases.title: Anything that can't be undone always asks for confirmation first

steps.action: Try deleting your account, deleting an appointment, and marking a completed task as not done.
steps.expected_result: All three ask you to confirm first, and cancelling any of them leaves everything untouched.

cases.title: Your account stays signed in across repeated app restarts

steps.action: Finish onboarding, then close and reopen the app several times.
steps.expected_result: You're never sent back through onboarding again just from restarting.

cases.title: Long lists stay smooth to scroll everywhere

steps.action: Fill My Path, a Resources category, Calendar, and Explore each with a large number of items.
steps.expected_result: Scrolling stays smooth on all of them, with no slowdowns or stutters.

cases.title: The web version behaves the same as the phone version, aside from the known YouTube difference

steps.action: Repeat the full onboarding-to-completed-task run in a web browser.
steps.expected_result: Everything matches the phone experience, except YouTube videos need a manual tap to start on web — that difference is expected, not a bug.

cases.title: The known gaps noted elsewhere never block the main flow

steps.action: Repeat the full run while deliberately checking the known gaps noted in Analytics Events and Network/Interruption/Device-State.
steps.expected_result: None of them stop you from finishing onboarding, adding a goal, completing a task, or viewing any resource — they're minor tracking or edge-case gaps, not blockers, and should be reported to the team as a simple list rather than urgent bugs.
